review_findings_addressed.description: validate_group_identity singleton bypass, directive omission, prevalidation
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Enforced representative bot ID equality check on singleton groups, added directive equality check in verdicts_match, and prevalidated all update groups before any atomic prefix commit.

review_findings_addressed.description: commit_prefix batch bounds and replay below watermark semantics
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Enforced bounded batch size (<= ledger.max_batch_size), and for updates below watermark queried inbox via read_keys to admit matching known replays rather than blindly failing with unseen_update_below_committed_offset.

review_findings_addressed.description: read_keys/response decoders key/version/generation binding, canonical digest match, receipt validation, error whitelist
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Enforced requested key count match, unique rows, requested key containment, positive versions/generation, verified decoded canonical value digests, validated apply receipts against expected operation_id/digest/summary/generation, and mapped backend errors through a finite whitelist of 60+ native kernel codes to prevent raw error reflection.

Added writer_quiesced: Bool parameter to reconcile_uncertain; absent key returns ReconciledUnknown('writer_quiescence_unproven') unless writer quiescence is proven True, returning ReconciledAbsent only when quiesced.

review_findings_addressed.description: Capacity reservation deltas across lifecycle transitions
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Replaced zero deltas with exact accounting against 20 total potential KV rows and 64 receipt credits: +18/+63 on accepted prefix commit; -1/-1 on claim; -17/-1 on result; 0/-1 on sending, outcome, completion.

review_findings_addressed.description: Resumable bootstrap on interrupted native DB initialization
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Intercepted db_already_exists in initialize_store, inspecting meta/bot_identity and meta/next_offset via read_keys to idempotently resume or complete bootstrap metadata application.

invariants_enforced: Exact apply digest parity (uos.telegram-store.apply.v2) matching native test vector 8825f9c2f07cbdc1dd35478403db4922b79abce9e485db0bd23ade6dfb8fe339
Row version/hash invariant: version=0 <=> absent & sha256 empty; version>0 <=> present & 64-hex sha256
Atomic whole-prefix commit: watermark + inbox + input rows committed in single atomic apply with reservation accounting (+18 rows, +63 receipts)
CAS and Read-Set consistency: expected_generation checked, read set assertions validated against database rows
Maximal 16-chunk result atomicity: up to 16 chunks of 4096-byte escaped payloads persisted atomically with result metadata
Durable SENDING persistence: chunk state transitioned to OutboxSending before HTTP transmission attempt
Send outcome persistence: chunk state updated to OutboxDelivered, OutboxFailed, or OutboxUncertain upon completion
Strict uncertainty reconciliation: lookup_operation used to reconcile unknown outcomes with writer quiescence proof without blind retry
Zero Python, zero native store mutations, all execution strictly through gleam-bound under pinned uos_env
